"""Build GitHub Trending Repos PowerPoint deck."""
import io
import matplotlib

from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.chart.data import ChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

SILVER   = RGBColor(0xC8, 0xD0, 0xD8)

LIGHT_BG = RGBColor(0xF0, 0xF4, 0xF8)
MID_GRAY = RGBColor(0x55, 0x6B, 0x82)

W = Inches(13.33)   # 16:9 width
H = Inches(7.5)     # 16:9 height

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def new_prs():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width  = W
    prs.slide_height = H
    return prs

def blank_slide(prs):
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]
    return prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

def fill_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_textbox(slide, text, left, top, width, height,
                font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return txb

def add_text_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                  align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=0, italic=False):
    p   = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = Pt(space_before)
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

def fig_to_image(fig):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
                facecolor='none', transparent=True)
    buf.seek(0)
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf

    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_textbox(slide, text, left, top, width, height,
                font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align

    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color

def new_prs():

def blank_slide(prs):
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]
    return prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

def fill_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_textbox(slide, text, left, top, width, height,
                font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return txb

def add_text_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                  align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=0, italic=False):
    p   = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = Pt(space_before)
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
                facecolor='none', transparent=True)
    buf.seek(0)
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf

def blank_slide(prs):
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]
    return prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)

def fill_bg(slide, color):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color, line_color=None):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    if line_color:
        shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    else:
        shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_textbox(slide, text, left, top, width, height,
                font_size=18, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, wrap=True, italic=False):
    txb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf  = txb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    p   = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return txb

def add_text_para(tf, text, font_size=16, bold=False, color=WHITE,
                  align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, space_before=0, italic=False):
    p   = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.alignment = align
    if space_before:
        p.space_before = Pt(space_before)
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.size   = Pt(font_size)
    run.font.bold   = bold
    run.font.italic = italic
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

def fig_to_image(fig):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
                facecolor='none', transparent=True)
    buf.seek(0)
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf

def accent_bar(slide, y=Inches(0.62), color=TEAL):
    add_rect(slide, Inches(0.4), y, Inches(0.06), Inches(0.38), color)

def slide_title(slide, title_text, subtitle_text=None, title_y=Inches(0.55)):
    accent_bar(slide, y=title_y - Inches(0.05))
    add_textbox(slide, title_text,
                left=Inches(0.6), top=title_y,
                width=Inches(12.1), height=Inches(0.6),

                    left=Inches(0.6), top=title_y + Inches(0.52),

# ── Slide 7: Community Engagement ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def slide7(prs):
    sl = blank_slide(prs)
    fill_bg(sl, NAVY)
    add_rect(sl, 0, 0, W, Inches(0.06), TEAL)

    slide_title(sl,
        "hermes-agent Draws 78 PRs and 42 Pushes — Community Activity Varies Widely",
        "Scatter plot: PRs vs. Pushes per repo (bubble size = stars)")

    names   = [r["name"]   for r in repos]
    stars   = [r["stars"]  for r in repos]
    pushes  = [r["pushes"] for r in repos]

    fig.patch.set_alpha(0.0)

    def tier_color(pr, push):
        total = pr + push
        if total >= 30: return "#F78C00"
        if total >= 5:  return "#179CAC"
        return "#556B82"

    for i, r in enumerate(repos):
        c  = tier_color(r["prs"], r["pushes"])

        ax.scatter(r["pushes"], r["prs"], s=sz, color=c,
                   alpha=0.85, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.5, zorder=3)

    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#556B82')

        # title
        add_textbox(sl, title,
                    Inches(1.0), ty + Inches(0.06), Inches(11.8), Inches(0.38),
                    font_size=13, bold=True, color=WHITE)

                    Inches(1.0), ty + Inches(0.44), Inches(11.8), Inches(0.45),
                    font_size=11, color=SILVER, italic=True)

        Inches(0.4), H - Inches(0.4), Inches(12.5), Inches(0.38),
        font_size=10, color=MID_GRAY, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    add_rect(sl, 0, H - Inches(0.05), W, Inches(0.05), TEAL)

def main():
    prs = new_prs()
    slide1(prs)
    slide2(prs)
    slide3(prs)
    slide4(prs)
    slide5(prs)
    slide6(prs)
    slide7(prs)
    slide8(prs)
    out = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"
    prs.save(out)
    print(f"Saved: {out}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
